items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Alfred Williams on drums, Yank on trombone, Sam Morgan on trumpet, then come Zeb clarinet, then come Johnny Dave banjo

ctx.x: I'll give you the band over there, the band I'm speaking about during them days was I line them up like how we used to line them up. First come the drum in a row, then come the trombone, Yank on trombone, Alfred Williams on drums, Yank on trombone, Sam Morgan on trumpet, then come Zeb clarinet, then come Johnny Dave banjo, and then come to beat the bass violin. They didn't use pianists? No, no pianists. Now and then they use a piano. They use it on the record. Yeah, they use piano to make records though, but most…
Oh yeah, they're sitting on the long row. Long row, that's right, yeah.

items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: Me and Alfred used to alternate with the duplex snare drum, you see. We alternate on parades.

ctx.x: You say you used to play these parades. You use the same drum as you've got here now?

Well, not this snare drum. I had another black. They both live. I had a black wood shell drum, similar to one like Happy Youth. And lots of parades in the later years, I used to use the same drum on his trapania used. Used to call it duplex snare drum. Oh, duplex. Me and Alfred used to alternate with the duplex snare drum, you see. We alternate on parades. If I go play a parade, he wouldn't be working with it. I get the snare drum from him.
Is that the one Alfred Williams got now, or is that a different one?

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: That time I was waking the day, he called me to go pull him jobs for him.

ctx.x: Alfred, no, I said, well, I said, relief him. That time I was waking the day, he called me to go pull him jobs for him. Well, that was the last Sunday I prayed. I believe that was around 50, I don't know if it was 52 or 55, something. But I know I wouldn't play no more because that was enough.

items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: I used it several times in some parades in the lately years with Poissy Huffer. Yeah, I've seen that drum. Yeah, when I used to relief Alfred sometimes

ctx.x: He might have told us that. I forgot.

Yeah, because I'm sure Alfred had that drum. I used it several times in some parades in the lately years with Poissy Huffer. Yeah, I've seen that drum. Yeah, when I used to relief Alfred sometimes and he'd be feeling bad.
I didn't know they made aluminum drums that far back.
